content:
lee: heads up — started a prune wave from app-of-apps and we're seeing a bunch of GPU pool apps stuck in Sync/Deleting. noticed a ton of helm presync jobs hung and aws errors about EIP association.

argocd-bot: sync failed for cluster/gpu-pool-* (pre-sync hook job hung) — recorded in events.

lee: snippet from argocd logs:```\ntime=2026-03-20T10:02:11Z level=error msg=\"pre-sync hook job failed\" app=gpu-pool-east-1 err=\"CreateNetworkInterface: InvalidIPAddress.InUse: The IP address eip-54.12.34.56 is already in use\"\n```

anita: seen this pattern before. usually Terraform drift where an EIP was detached from an autoscaling node but left associated in AWS state. ArgoCD tries to prune/create and Helm hook jobs wait on the network resource.

sam: checked terraform state bucket (s3://infra-tf-state/prod): last apply 2 days ago. Found orphaned resources: `aws_eip.eip_gpu_pool_east1a` exists in AWS but not associated in TF config. likely from a failed node replacement.

infra-oncall: I can run a manual import to TF state to avoid double-creates. Before I do that — can we limit the prune fanout? this wave is blasting 120 apps at once and spiking API throttles. we should reduce argocd.app.of.apps.sync.concurrency and prune.concurrentWorkers.

deploy-bot: retriggering app-of-apps sync with exponential backoff, batch_size=6 (requested by @infra-oncall).

lee: temporary manual workaround: delete the stuck helm presync Job for `gpu-pool-east-1a` (kube-system) and argocd will mark hook as failed/complete then continue. doing that now.

anita: 👍 I'll open a TF PR to import the orphaned EIPs and add a lifecycle rule + doc for node replacement to prevent future leakage. Also adding an automated check in infra-monitoring to detect orphaned EIPs > 1h.

sam: FYI those leaked EIPs are costing ~$120/day across accounts. tagging cost-ops and owners.

infra-oncall: imported eip-54.12.34.56 into TF state (performed `terraform import aws_eip.eip_gpu_pool_east1a eipalloc-0a1b2c3d`). retriggered `terraform plan` and applied minimal fix. retriggering argocd sync for affected apps now. apps are progressing :tada:

lee: great — once stable let's ship a small argocd config change: reduce prune concurrency and add backoff/jitter to app-of-apps fanout. also postmortem + runbook for EIP lifecycle.

anita: opening PRs for terraform import + argocd config. will add a short runbook in eng-infra/wiki.

sam: leaving a note to billing too. followup: postmortem in #postmortems with timeline and remediation.

infra-oncall: closing the loop here, will ping once the PRs merge and the new defaults roll out. thanks everyone.
